👮 **Wachiman** · review of the whole pull request, at `1fb882c`: all 6 files reviewed.

2 finding(s): 2 to consider; 1 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Outside the diff

- 🟡📝 **Consider · docs: `FLAG_DEFAULTS` docstring still says "experiments stay off" (confidence high)** (`apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/analytics.ts:19`): The docstring above `FLAG_DEFAULTS` says the defaults are chosen so "experiments stay off" when a flag is unresolved. `native-cursor-capture` now defaults to `true`, so an offline or diagnostics-off install records natively. Update the sentence so it covers a default-on kill-switch flag, matching the new inline comment at lines 23-25.

### Summary

The change does what it claims. The toast gating is correct: on Windows and Linux the capability check would otherwise fire a fallback toast on every take, now that the flag defaults to true. The release checks close the gap where the helper build only warned. Two docs-level notes, both \"consider\". First, the runbook says the 0% kill switch reaches every build, but `isFlagEnabled` falls back to the new `true` default whenever PostHog isn't started, for example when the user has turned Send diagnostics off. Second, the `FLAG_DEFAULTS` docstring still says experiments stay off.

<details><summary>What the change connects to (3 closed, 0 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**
- Native-capture decision messages are toasted only in dev builds; packaged builds log them with console.info (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:522-525`) — Packaged users no longer see an English diagnostic toast on every take. This matters on Windows/Linux, where the flag now defaults true, capability returns experimentalRequested=true with transportAvailable=false, and the toast would otherwise fire on every take. If it fails: When native falls back in a packaged build, the user sees nothing and the take records via Chromium, so the editable cursor is missing. This is intentional; the trace goes to the console only. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:421-475`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/native/ipc.ts:50-61`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:1411-1418`.
- native-cursor-capture default flipped to true; PostHog flag kept as kill switch (`apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/analytics.ts:26`) — Eligible Screen/Window takes on macOS open the native helper when it validates, and the editor gets the Cursor entry. If it fails: Installs with diagnostics off, no PostHog key, or no cached flags while offline always read true, so the remote kill switch can't reach them (reported as a finding). Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/analytics/analytics-client.ts:74-80`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/analytics/analytics-client.ts:28-31`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/services/settings.service.ts:159-162`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:422-429`.
- Release workflow fails if the universal helper is missing after build, or unsigned/without hardened runtime after packaging (`.github/workflows/release-desktop.yml:182-245`) — A release can no longer ship without the helper or with an improperly signed one. If it fails: The job fails with an ::error annotation; nothing is published. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/scripts/build-encoded-capture.sh:10-33`, `apps/kaipu-record/package.json:32`, `apps/kaipu-record/electron-builder.yml:20-22`, `apps/kaipu-record/electron-builder.yml:44`.
